design.name: 白泽
design.brief: The Baize (白泽), the all-knowing white beast of Chinese legend that taught the names of every demon: a wise lion-goat-like white quadruped with a long silky beard, curling ram horns, a third eye on its forehead and three extra eyes along each flank, a scholar's scroll case strapped to its back from which glowing yellow talisman papers unfurl and float around it; the forehead eye glows pale jade-green (weak spot). Cloven hooves. Calm, ancient, protective.
design.weapon: reading an unrolled scroll held in its mouth, talismans flying out
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, paper and cloth as thick simple bands, fur as big carved clumps. Real goat/lion anatomy under the stylization.
